# Throwing

Small fixes to upstream throwing. A thrown item networks its thrower; when the thrower is deleted mid-flight (a body
gibbed as it throws its parts) every state sent logged an error. `WGThrowerSystem` keeps the thrower's items in flight
on a `WGThrowerComponent` and clears their thrower as it is deleted; `ThrowingSystem.TryThrow` doesn't record a thrower
that is already being deleted.
